skill.name: speech-to-text
skill.description: Transcribes audio with Whisper models through the inference.sh CLI. Supports multilingual transcription, English translation, and optional timestamps for captions or transcripts.
skill.summary: Convert audio recordings into transcripts, subtitles, or English translations with inference.sh Whisper models.
skill.author: inference-sh-9

security_audit.summary: Most Ruby backtick detections are false positives caused by Markdown fences and inline code. The Quick Start contains a confirmed curl-to-shell installer, and its installer URL is part of the same critical remote code execution risk. No prompt injection text or hidden exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-shell setup with manual download steps, pinned release versions, and checksum verification before execution.
Link to signed release artifacts and checksums instead of executing the latest script from a remote URL.
Disclose that audio URLs or media content are processed by inference.sh, and warn users about sensitive recordings.

content.value_statement: Audio and video recordings are hard to search or reuse without accurate transcripts. This skill uses inference.sh Whisper models to create transcripts, translations, and timestamped segments.
actual_capabilities: Runs inference.sh Whisper transcription apps from documented CLI examples.
Transcribes audio URLs into full text output.
Requests timestamped segments for captions and review workflows.
Translates supported non-English audio to English with Whisper V3 Large.
Shows a video-to-audio workflow before transcription.
Documents output fields for text, segments, and detected language.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and an authenticated account.
Processes audio through an external inference.sh service.
Examples focus on URL inputs, not local audio file upload.
The current installer command uses a remote shell script and needs safer setup guidance.

use_cases.title: Create meeting transcripts
use_cases.description: Convert recorded meetings into readable text for notes, search, and follow-up tasks.

use_cases.title: Prepare podcast transcripts
use_cases.description: Turn podcast audio into text that can support editing, summaries, and publishing.

use_cases.title: Build subtitle source text
use_cases.description: Generate timestamped transcript segments that can be used as caption inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Transcribe a meeting
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to transcribe this meeting audio URL: [audio URL]. Return the full text and detected language.

prompt_templates.title: Generate timestamped text
prompt_templates.prompt: Transcribe this podcast audio URL with timestamps: [audio URL]. Provide the transcript and segment timing summary.

prompt_templates.title: Translate audio to English
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Whisper V3 Large to translate this non-English audio URL to English: [audio URL]. Return clear English transcript text.

prompt_templates.title: Create a caption workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract audio from this video URL, transcribe it with timestamps, and prepare caption-ready text: [video URL]. Show each step.

output_examples.input: A meeting recording URL with English speech.
output_examples.output: A full transcript with detected English language and paragraph breaks for review.

output_examples.input: A podcast episode URL with timestamp request enabled.
output_examples.output: A transcript split into timed segments that can guide editing and captions.

output_examples.input: A French audio recording URL with translation requested.
output_examples.output: An English transcript that preserves the main spoken content.

best_practices: Use audio sources that you are allowed to process through inference.sh.
Request timestamps when the transcript will support captions or editing.
Review transcripts for names, technical terms, and unclear speech.
anti_patterns: Do not send confidential recordings without approval from the data owner.
Do not rely on raw transcripts as final legal or medical records.
Do not run remote installer scripts without checking the source and checksum.

faq.question: What audio models does this skill use?
faq.answer: It documents Fast Whisper Large V3 and Whisper V3 Large through inference.sh app IDs.

faq.question: Can it create timestamps?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill shows timestamped transcription input for segment-level output.

faq.question: Can it translate audio?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes an example that translates non-English audio to English.

faq.question: Does it work with video?
faq.answer: It shows a workflow that extracts audio from video before transcription.

faq.question: Does it require an external service?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses the inference.sh CLI and cloud apps to process transcription requests.

faq.question: Is the setup command safe for automatic install?
faq.answer: No. The current Quick Start uses a curl-to-shell installer and should be replaced.
